summary.storyTitle: Story 5: Attach And Import Existing PI Sessions
summary.implementedScope: Fixed the verifier blockers by serializing the full attach/import operation against same-thread live capture, reusing the capture internals without double-locking, and narrowing partial-import repair marking to the source ranges of actual import issues.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

evidence: Regression test confirms live capture waits behind import and sourceOrder lands outside importedSourceRange.
Regression test confirms only affected imported turns are marked repair_needed.

changedFiles.reason: Exposed an internal capture helper so import can hold the per-thread serializer across the whole operation without deadlocking canonical capture.
Wrapped thread creation and import finalization in the same thread operation and scoped repair_needed turn marking to issue source ranges.
Added estimated source ranges to skipped PI path-entry issues so structural partial imports can be repaired narrowly.
Added live-capture/import overlap regression coverage and updated partial-import expectations to mark only affected turns repair_needed.
